headline: Minus 13.8 billion yuan! Tencent Holdings' Q2 free cash flow turns negative, following US tech giant Google; Chinese and American internet giants simultaneously face awkward situations, running out of cash!
summary: Tencent Holdings' free cash flow in the second quarter was negative, at minus 13.8 billion yuan. The report also compares it with Google's cash position in the US.
why: Tencent is a Chinese internet and gaming conglomerate, and free cash flow shows how much cash remains after capital spending to fund dividends and buybacks.
